blogs.title: Can a 7B Model Really Beat the Giants? Meet DeepSeekMath
blogs.description: A high-level overview of how DeepSeekMath is closing the gap between open-source models and industry titans like GPT-4 and Gemini-Ultra. This post explains how strategic data selection and innovative training can allow a smaller model to punch way above its weight class in complex mathematical reasoning.

blogs.title: Mining the Web for Math: The Secret Behind the DeepSeekMath Corpus
blogs.description: An exploration of the 'data alchemy' used to create a 120-billion token math dataset from the Common Crawl. This post discusses the iterative pipeline used to filter high-quality content and shares the surprising discovery that arXiv papers may not be as effective for math benchmarks as previously thought.

blogs.title: Smarter, Faster, Leaner: Understanding Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
blogs.description: A beginner-friendly dive into the technical innovation of GRPO. This post explains how this new reinforcement learning algorithm removes the need for a bulky 'critic' model, reducing memory usage while significantly boosting the model's ability to arrive at the correct mathematical answer.

blogs.title: The Coding Connection: Why AI Needs to Learn Python to Master Calculus
blogs.description: An investigation into the surprising synergy between code and math. This post explains the research findings on why initializing a model with coding data improves its mathematical reasoning capabilities, both when using external tools and when thinking through problems in natural language.
